# Phase 1 fixture corpus: slug<TAB>url
#
# Fetch with:  python scripts/fetch_fixtures.py
# Run it on the Pi -- the build container's network policy blocks these hosts.
#
# What makes a good fixture: a real, messy, production page of a shape the Harvester
# will actually meet. The mix below is deliberate --
#   *_home     marketing homepages (the common case, heavy JS shells, sparse text)
#   *_about    company/about pages (headcount, location, founding date)
#   *_careers  job listings (the T3/T4/T11 hiring triggers live here)
#   security vendors are included ON PURPOSE as anti-ICP negatives: the extractor
#   must be able to describe them, and the ComplianceGate must later reject them.
#
# The Phase 1 gate is schema validity (>= 95%), which needs realistic HTML but no
# labels. Hand-labelling happens in Phase 3 for the 50-item golden set.
